reaction: Ada comes with him but is not counted among the six - is she the seventh who needs a bed? Asking Kian for a road story; his line This is good enough for me is sweetly flat.
Up and down: the people pages and Maryam knot line pulled me back in, but my shelter is unused and the store empty, and I do not know what lever makes anyone sleep below.
Experiment: ring the bell at night to see if they go below. I know false alarms weaken trust - I accept the cost to learn the rule.

Everyone below, even after my false alarm. But every line says Riders can reach this passage and the door is still open. They are standing near the entrance in the first room, ABOVE my door. I cannot tell anyone to go through and shut it. My hands are tied; I only watch now.
They pray, they eat, then they will come. Riders half a day away. Tense in a good way, and I am completely powerless. Watching.

I would come back only if something told me what my chalk is waiting for.
